pages.text: File $(l)world/serverconfig/rpmedicine-server.toml$() — every number of the mod, commented in Russian. In this book config values are $(cfg)coloured$() — the defaults are shown.

- $(l)knockdownMin/MaxSeconds$() — knockdown timer.$(br)- $(l)dosingMinLevel$(), $(l)numbersMinLevel$(), $(l)labMinLevel$().$(br)- $(l)ivHoseLength$() — IV hose.$(br)- $(l)bookSkillGating$() — this book's sections by Medicine level ($(cfg)false$() — everything for everyone).
- $(l)organsEnabled$(), $(l)infectionEnabled$(), $(l)nutritionEnabled$(), $(l)substancesEnabled$() — systems that can be switched off.
